page.overview:
Who is Hyoutauros?

Hyoutauros is a former member of the Centaur Patrol Unit under Brownbeard, having served as one of Caesar Clown’s henchmen. He is a jaguar centaur.

Hyoutauros is a large, muscular jaguar centaur with tan skin and a long blond beard. He has small dark eyes, a wide nose, and predominant cheekbones. He wears a striped blue cap and a jaguar print top over his left shoulder.

Hyoutauros is a bit absent-minded, as he mistook Monkey D. Luffy for a centaur (when Luffy had Kin'emon's legs attached to him). He is also persistent, which was shown when he pursued Luffy, threw a boulder at him from a distance, and called to his comrades after being injured for the sake of stopping invaders.

Despite his stature, Hyoutauros is not very strong compared to Luffy, who defeated him with a single hit. Regardless, he was able to regain consciousness quickly, pursue Luffy and his crew, and throw a boulder a decent distance at them, showing that he still had some strength despite being injured.
